svg.title: The voice tail and the agents' throughput
svg.desc: Each configuration's voice-to-voice p95 as a bar from zero against the SLO of 2.03 s, and its agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, each at the median of its runs with their spread: voice alone, no agents: 1.78 s at the median of 5 runs (1.76 to 1.82 s); tuned vLLM, the baseline: 10.48 s at the median of 10 runs (8.69 to 12.12 s), its agents at 3,305 tokens/s, 100% of tuned vLLM's; preempt-resubmit, before the first byte: 2.52 s at the median of 5 runs (2.52 to 2.87 s), its agents at 3,332 tokens/s, 101% of tuned vLLM's; the KV preemption, #63350: 5.09 s at the median of 5 runs (4.69 to 6.26 s), its agents at 3,414 tokens/s, 103% of tuned vLLM's; the change, 16-token window: 3.09 s at the median of 5 runs (2.87 to 3.19 s), its agents at 3,298 tokens/s, 100% of tuned vLLM's; and the configuration to deploy, 48-token window: 2.24 s at the median of 15 runs (2.13 to 2.40 s), 0.20 s over the SLO, its agents at 3,203 tokens/s, 97% of tuned vLLM's.
svg.text: Tokens/s over the calls' first 240 s
